image_location_description: Left side: big light/dark bluish gray rectangular block with many studs on top

steps.title: Base plates (4x6)
steps.description: Place 2x Plate 2x6 (3795) Dark Bluish Gray side-by-side to make 4x6.

steps.title: Middle layer start
steps.description: Add 2x Brick 2x4 (3001) Dark Bluish Gray on one 4x4 end (side-by-side).

steps.title: Middle layer finish
steps.description: Add 1x Brick 2x4 (3001) Dark Bluish Gray rotated to fill the remaining 4x2 end.

steps.title: Upper layer main
steps.description: Stack 2x Brick 2x4 (3001) Light Bluish Gray over the 4x4 end (same layout).

steps.title: Upper layer fill
steps.description: Fill the remaining 4x2 end with 4x Brick 1x2 (3004) Light Bluish Gray.

steps.title: Top cap (studs)
steps.description: Cap with 2x Plate 2x6 (3795) Light Bluish Gray side-by-side, keep studs up.
